priya: Heads-up: customers want one-page clarity on what the Optimize toolkit pilot includes. We should define alpha ship scope tonight.
sam: Suggestion for alpha: read-only recommendations in Console (batching/caching/quant) + eval-trigger webhook with debouncing. No auto-apply until beta.
mika: Add: per-route metadata to opt-out/force-no-quant. Customers need an easy knob.
kai: Engineering constraints: we can compute cache_hit_rate and batch_size metrics from a 1% trace sampler. Full per-request tracing is heavy; keep traces sampled for alpha.
jordan: SRE: require an ops fallback if p95 increases > 15% after applying recs. For alpha, since it's read-only, document the manual rollback steps and alerting policy.
priya: Draft alpha acceptance checklist:
- Console surfaces recommendations with short rationale + confidence
- Eval-alerts delivered to webhook, debounced (see policy below)
- Route metadata key `no_quant=true` respected
- Basic telemetry: batch_size_avg, cache_hit_rate, quant_confidence

sam: Debounce policy: fire alert only after 3 failing eval runs in 24h OR a sustained metric delta > 2 sigma across 6h. Include a human-friendly "why" and a hashed_prompt_id in payload for privacy.
mika: Docs: include CLI rollback example:
```
# disable advisor on route
redwood routes patch my-route --metadata '{"no_quant":true}'
```
kai: Perf plan: run baseline vs suggested config on three profiles (chat_short, long_doc, streaming). Capture p50/p95/p99 and eval score delta. Alpha only needs simulated quant estimates (int8/fp16) not live quantized runs.
priya: Pilot timeline: prototype (4d) -> console UI (6d) -> eval webhook (4d). Alpha run 14 days with 3 customers. Sign-off: no high-severity eval regressions and at least 1 of 3 customers seeing >=20% cache_hit_rate on recommended routes or a documented mitigation.
jordan: Ops: create dashboard tile "advisor-impact" showing before/after p95 and cache_hit_rate. Add runbook: if p95_up > 15% or error_rate > 1%, rollback and page on-call.
sam: Risks: wrong quant recs -> quality regressions. Mitigation: require A/B with eval shard before any auto-apply and surface confidence score.
priya: Action items: kai prototype sampler (3d), mika draft pilot docs (4d), sam confirm pilot customers (2d), jordan build dashboard scaffold (5d). Reconvene in 48h. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy note: branch optimize-alpha -> staged; e2e queued :gear:
